$comment: Source of truth for the dotfmt.format.* VS Code settings. Run `bun generate-settings.ts` after editing, and `bun generate-settings.ts --check` in CI. Rust `Config::default` and each language's `set` are the source of truth for types, ranges and defaults. `enum` names the canonical values, and the description mentions the common aliases that `set` also matches. `default` is the effective value when nothing sets the option and is rendered into the setting description, never into a VS Code default.

width.defaultDescription: each language's own value — 80 everywhere except Lua, which uses 120
width.description: Line width used where a language wraps: BibTeX and LaTeX prose, Lua lines, Markdown tables, YAML flow collections, TOML arrays and inline tables, and TypeScript, CSS and HTML output. Accepted and ignored by env, ignore, ini and plist; CSS, HTML and TypeScript cap it at 320.

indent.defaultDescription: each language's own value — 2 spaces, except ini, which keeps its dialect's indentation
indent.description: Spaces per indentation level. Most languages accept 1 to 16, CSS, HTML and TypeScript accept 0 to 24, and the JSON block also takes `-1` for tabs or `0` for compact JSON. Env, ignore and markdown ignore it.

final_newline.defaultDescription: each language's own value — `true` for JSON, TOML, YAML, plist, env, ini, CSS, HTML and TypeScript, and `false` for Bib, conf, ignore, LaTeX, Lua and Markdown
final_newline.description: Write a trailing newline at the end of every file.

repair.description: Repair near-valid input before formatting instead of reporting a syntax error. Only JSON/JSONC/JSONL, Lua, TOML and YAML implement repairs; the other languages leave malformed input unchanged.

quote_style.defaultDescription: each language's own preference — `double` for TypeScript, CSS and HTML, and `auto-prefer-double` for Lua and YAML
quote_style.description: Quote character preference for the languages that rewrite quoting: Lua and YAML strings, plus TypeScript, CSS and HTML. JSON always emits double quotes, and bib, conf, env, ignore, ini, LaTeX, Markdown, plist and TOML preserve the source quoting.

included_files.description: Gitignore-style patterns that add eligible files, one pattern per entry. A file is eligible when any configuration layer matches; a language's `include` adds custom mappings instead of filtering.

excluded_files.description: Gitignore-style patterns removed from formatting, one pattern per entry, after `included_files` is applied.

enabled.defaultDescription: the language's `dotfmt.dotfile` state — the engine starts with every language disabled, and the shipped configuration enables all of them except JavaScript
enabled.description: Enable or disable this language. `false` disables it even when another layer enables it. In native settings, an empty language block changes nothing; use `dotfmt.format.<language>.enabled` explicitly.

include.description: Additional gitignore-style filename mappings for this language, one pattern per entry, on top of its built-in extensions. An explicitly empty list resets the inherited mappings.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style patterns skipped for this language only, one pattern per entry. An explicitly empty list resets the inherited patterns.

repair.description: Repair near-valid input in this language before formatting. Only JSON/JSONC/JSONL, Lua, TOML and YAML implement repairs; the other languages leave malformed input unchanged.

width.description: Wrap long field values at this width.

indent.description: Spaces per indentation level for wrapped values.

indent_type.description: Indentation character: `indent` spaces or a single tab.

line_endings.description: Line endings written for the whole file: `unix` (LF) or `windows` (CRLF).

final_newline.description: Write a trailing newline at the end of the file.

blank_lines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept between entries.

align.description: Align `=` across the fields of an entry. Field names wider than `align_max` fall back to one space.

align_max.description: Widest field name that alignment pads; `0` removes the cap.

trailing_comma.description: Write a comma after an entry's last field. `@string` definitions never get one.

wrap.description: Break values wider than `width` at existing spaces. Values are never rewritten, only wrapped.

wrap_min.description: Only wrap a value when its first line is longer than this.

field_name_case.description: Case for field names and `@string` definition names; macro uses keep their spelling.

entry_type_case.description: Case for entry types such as `@article`.

align.description: Align keys, values and trailing comments within contiguous blocks.

align_max.description: Widest key column that alignment pads; longer keys fall back to one space.

blank_lines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept between blocks.

final_newline.description: Write a trailing newline at the end of the file.

dialect.description: Stylesheet syntax; `auto` reads the extension, and `pcss` is accepted as an alias for `css`.

indent_type.description: Indentation character: `indent` spaces or a single tab.

width.description: Target line width for declarations and selectors.

final_newline.description: Write a trailing newline at the end of the file.

line_endings.description: Line endings written for the whole file: `unix`/`lf` (LF) or `windows`/`crlf` (CRLF).

quotes.description: Quotation style for strings and `url()` values; `preserve`/`auto` keep the source style, and `prefer-*` keep it unless the other quote needs fewer escapes.

quote_style.description: Alias of `quotes`, so the shared `quote_style` setting applies to CSS.

format_comments.description: Rewrite comment text, not only its placement.

align_comments.description: Align trailing comments within a group of declarations.

single_line_block_threshold.description: Put a declaration block on one line when its content fits in this many characters.

operator_linebreak.description: Break before or after an operator when a value wraps.

block_selector_linebreak.description: Where `{` goes when a selector list does not fit: break before it always, follow what the first selector does, or break only when needed.

keyframe_selector_notation.defaultDescription: unset — the source notation is preserved
keyframe_selector_notation.description: Rewrite keyframe selectors as `from`/`to` (`keyword`) or percentages; `none` preserves them.

prefer_single_line.description: Prefer keeping short constructs on one line.

declaration_order.defaultDescription: unset — declarations keep their source order
declaration_order.description: Sort declarations inside each block; `none` keeps the source order.

tailwind.description: Tailwind class sorting: `auto` engages only when the file or project uses Tailwind. `true` and `false` are accepted aliases for `on` and `off`.

tailwind_order.description: Where the class order comes from: the project's own Tailwind, the Rust pattern sorter, or `auto` (project when available, Rust otherwise).

tailwind_dedupe.description: Remove duplicate classes from a class list.

tailwind_merge.description: Collapse conflicting utilities with `tailwind-merge`. Off by default because merging can change rendering.

tailwind_stylesheet.defaultDescription: unset — the project's stylesheet is discovered
tailwind_stylesheet.description: Stylesheet that declares the Tailwind theme used for ordering.

tailwind_config.defaultDescription: unset — the project's Tailwind config is discovered
tailwind_config.description: Tailwind config file used for ordering.

indent.description: Accepted from the shared block and unused: dotenv has no nesting.

width.description: Accepted from the shared block and unused: dotenv values are never wrapped.

line_endings.description: Line endings written for the whole file: `unix` (LF) or `windows` (CRLF).

blank_lines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept between items.

align.description: Write `key = value` and align `=` within contiguous entry groups. Off by default because not every shell or container env-file reader accepts spaces around `=`.

align_max.description: Widest entry prefix that alignment pads; longer keys fall back to one space.

format_comments.description: Insert a space after `#` in comments where one is missing.

trim_trailing_whitespace.description: Trim whitespace that trails an item outside a quoted value; backslash-escaped whitespace is value content and stays.

closing_bracket_same_line.description: Put the closing `>` of a multi-line opening tag on the last attribute's line.

closing_tag_line_break_for_empty.description: Put an empty element's closing tag on its own line always, only when it does not fit, or never.

max_attrs_per_line.description: Write at most this many attributes on one line.

prefer_attrs_single_line.description: Keep all attributes on one line when they fit.

single_attr_same_line.description: Keep a single attribute on the same line as the tag name.

trim_leading_whitespace.description: Drop leading whitespace from `.gitattributes` lines; other dialects treat leading whitespace as pattern data.

format_comments.description: Insert a space after `#` on comment lines where that is safe.

align.description: Align the `.gitattributes` attribute column; other dialects leave their patterns alone.

align_max.description: Widest pattern that alignment pads; `0` means no cap, and longer patterns fall back to one space.

dialect.description: Ini syntax; `auto` detects it from the filename and path. Aliases `ini`, `conf`, `gitconfig`, `editor-config`, `unit` and `ssh-config` are accepted.

indent_type.description: Indentation character at the start of a line.

dialect.description: JSON syntax; `auto` lets comments decide between JSON and JSONC and the extension pick JSONL. Aliases `json-with-comments`, `jwcc`, `ndjson` and `jsonlines` are accepted.

indent.description: `-1` indents with tabs, `0` emits compact JSON like `jq -c`, and `1` to `7` indent with that many spaces. JSONL ignores it and writes one compact record per line.

quote_properties.description: Object key quotes: only when needed, preserved from the source, or one style consistently.

trailing_commas.description: Where to write trailing commas in multi-line lists.

bracket_same_line.description: Put the closing `>` of a multi-line JSX tag on the last attribute's line.

attribute_position.description: Attribute wrapping for JSX elements: `multiline` breaks every attribute once the tag breaks.

expand.description: Object literals: `auto`/`preserve` keep an object multi-line when the source wrote a newline after `{`, and `never`/`collapse` also collapse it onto one line when it fits.

object_wrap.description: Alias of `expand`, matching the Prettier `objectWrap` spelling.

embedded_css.description: Format CSS inside CSS-in-JS template literals with the CSS formatter.

import_side_effects.description: Sort side-effect imports together with the other groups.

import_newlines.description: Write a blank line between import groups.

import_partition_by_newline.description: Keep the source's blank lines between import groups.

import_partition_by_comment.description: Keep the source's comments between import groups.

import_groups.description: Custom import groups: `|` separates groups and `+` joins entries in one group, for example `type+builtin | external | parent+sibling`. `default`, `perfectionist`, `biome` and `none` keep the built-in order.

fixes.description: Preset for format-time fixes: `off`, `safe` (unused imports, type-only conversion, organize imports) or `unsafe` (safe plus unused locals). `none` and `all` are aliases; export removal is never implied.

remove_unused_imports.description: Remove unused imports; a bare side-effect-only import keeps its side effect.

remove_unused_exports.description: Remove project-wide unused exports. Unsafe: needs project analysis and a trusted workspace.

remove_unused_parameters.description: Diagnose-only: `--diagnose` reports unused parameters, and formatting never removes them.

convert_type_only_imports.description: Convert imports used only as types to `import type`.

organize_imports.description: Sort and group import runs, applying their import fixes.

type_aware.description: Run the project's `tsc --noEmit` once and keep errors only. Project checks require a trusted workspace.

verify.description: Fail when formatting would remove code compared with the input.
